blocks.text: TED UNIVERSITY
CMPE 492 Senior Design Project II
BioAuth TODO and Backlog
Version 1 | 15 October 2026 | First delivery: 16 October 2026

This backlog translates the BioAuth V2 low-level design into implementation and verification work. The existing public website is an earlier prototype. Actual backend completion and individual ownership have not been confirmed; implementation items are therefore recorded as Planned, and ownership is expressed as a proposed role. Team assignment and effort estimates are set during sprint planning.
Status and planning conventions

Planned: work is specified but completion is unverified. Review: a deliverable is prepared and awaits team/advisor review. Deferred: excluded from the initial implementation. Priority P0 blocks correctness or the first working verification; P1 supports evaluation and delivery; P2 is an extension. Dates below are proposed internal targets except the course deadlines.

rows: Team review, PDF delivery and project-site publication.
Advisor feedback incorporated and scope changes recorded.
Real evidence contracts, physiological gate and review activation work.
L1/C-Q/L2 and authorized event flow execute on real inputs.
Test procedures, splits, responsibilities and denominators approved.
Thresholds/models fixed before final test; L3 assessed if data supports it.
Measured results, limitations, reproducible installation and updated documentation.
Recorded/live demonstration materials ready for announced date.

For LLD: upload the PDF to LMS, email the supervisor and jury, complete the coordinator form and publish the report on the project site. Publish the backlog version on the site. These submission actions remain team tasks; preparing these files does not perform submission.

Dependencies and risks

rows: Start permission requests early; use consented controlled recordings for matched features without overstating sample diversity.
Short capture cannot yield usable rPPG
Measure duration/quality trade-off. Keep mandatory rPPG gate; submit justified timing change rather than silently accepting without it.
Report species-specific failure; evaluate model adaptation on training/validation data only.
Qualify encoding against lossless input and revise capture profile before final comparison.
Preserve core, safety gates and C-Q/L2 research. Keep optical/native/deep-rPPG deferred; review L3 scheduling explicitly.
Use permitted artifacts and documented retrieval; do not bundle unapproved weights or datasets.
Enforce encrypted temporary storage, reviewer-only access and automatic expiry/deletion.
Clearly label simulation and update content/report links as each delivery is completed.

blocks.text: Weekly update procedure

At each team meeting, confirm individual owners, status, blockers and completion evidence. Move an item to Complete only with a linked commit, test result or reviewed deliverable. Re-estimate remaining work and preserve each dated backlog version. Course deadlines take precedence over proposed internal targets.
Source and scope

Sources: CMPE 492 Syllabus New.pdf; BioAuth V2 Design Baseline v2.0; BioAuth Low Level Design Report v1. The backlog includes the accepted design clarifications from the preparation session. Individual team assignments and completed implementation are not inferred from the earlier simulation website.
